schema.title: SARIF External Property File Schema Version 2.1.0-rtm.4 JSON Schema

description:
Dear Team,

Please find below the details of the external properties that will be merged with the upcoming SARIF run. The file conforms to the SARIF External Property File schema located at https://json.schemastore.org/sarif-external-property-file-2.1.0-rtm.4.json and uses version 2.1.0 of the format. The unique identifier for this property set is 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000, and it is associated with the run identified by the GUID 987e6543-e21b-34d5-b789-123456789abc.

The properties included are a brief comment—“Sample external properties for demonstration purposes”—the tool that generated them, “ExampleTool v1.0”, and the creation timestamp 2026-06-15T12:34:56Z. Let me know if any further information is required.
